entries.what: Linh bikes to campus for a morning of notes after skipping breakfast, then works the Monday 12-6 shift at Heron & Grind, pulling shots beside Jun and serving Wes his cortado.
entries.outcome: Shift ran smoothly; Wes called her Doc again.

entries.what: Biked home to Pell Road; Hạnh left a plate and Linh ate it cold while recoloring her anatomy notes in pink and blue.

After Anatomy and a lab review, Linh skipped lunch on her break to build Jun's per-roll cost spreadsheet for Lola's Roll, pulling fat and sodium numbers for the label and getting oddly excited about it.
entries.outcome: Finished the cost-per-roll sheet and gave it to Jun for free.

entries.what: Kenji gave her a ride to chemistry class and she ate half a granola bar at 2 p.m. because she realized she hadn't eaten.
entries.outcome: Got through chem lecture on a snack.

entries.what: Evening at home with the flashcard deck, reviewing 40 anatomy cards, then planning the week in her washi-tape planner.
Wednesday Anatomy at 9 with Dr. Okoye, sitting next to Rochelle, who asked three questions in a row.
entries.outcome: Took color-coded notes on the nervous system.

entries.what: Worked the Wednesday 12-6 shift at Heron & Grind; Jun showed her another pour and thanked her for the sheet between orders.
Phone battery died on the ride home so she plugged in and finished Statistics homework on Thao's old laptop.
Kenji drove her to General Chemistry at 11; she ate a late lunch of leftover rice in the parking lot.
Studied alone in the library for two hours instead of joining a study group, then rode home.
Thao texted before her night shift; Linh replied with a short okay and promised to eat dinner.
Friday Anatomy at 9, then a quiet afternoon of flashcards at Heron & Grind on her day off, sitting at the vault-wall outlets.
entries.outcome: Reviewed 80 cards with Kenji quizzing her.

entries.what: Helped Hạnh with grocery shopping at Ruiz Family Market and cooked dinner prep for the weekend.
Went to bed at 12:30 after sorting weekend planner pages.
entries.outcome: Set alarm for the 6:30 Saturday opening.

entries.what: Opened Heron & Grind at 6:30 for the Saturday shift; the Ridgeline hiring fair lines downtown meant a rush of students and parents grabbing coffee early.
Thao covered a replacement bike lock for Linh; on break Linh asked for a cheap thank-you gift idea and settled on a coffee bean bag and phở.
Saw Aaliyah's friend group celebrating getting hired at the Ridgeline fair; Rochelle texted Linh that Aaliyah got a seasonal picker spot.
Worked the Sunday 6:30-1 shift, then went to Lotus Nails to work the front desk from 2 to 5.
Before Sunday dinner with Hạnh she wanted talking points on pharmacy but ended up asking for ways to change the subject; the pharmacy talk stayed postponed.
Planned next week in her washi-tape planner and took a short walk on the marsh boardwalk first.
